rule_or_requirement: A learned pixel-only speed policy must preserve valid completion while improving lap time against the selected pixel control.
observable_information: Rendered pixels, inherited pixel-driver action and learned three-class posterior at inference; local matched completion, lap, collision and latency telemetry for evaluation.
allowed_action_or_state_change: On clear low-steer observations, confidently predicted boost sets gas 0.28 and coast sets gas zero, leaving inherited steering and braking unchanged.
expected_success_endpoint: At least selected valid completion, zero invalid actions, one hundred boosts and twenty coasts, and at least 2% paired median lap improvement when completion ties.
control: Unchanged selected stable-risk pixel driver on exactly the same twelve TRAIN cells.
falsifier: Candidate-only valid-completion loss, inactive boost or coast, invalid actions, or insufficient paired lap gain on a completion tie.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two frozen pixel-only arms on tracks 1–3 × unused TRAIN seeds 5020–5023, twenty-four registered episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU diagnostic capped at 1,800 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no TUNE, held-out, confirmation, blind, official or external action.
